title: EEG2MCU: Sensing-to-Execution Co-Design for Wearable EEG Inference
abstract: arXiv:2611.23619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Wearable EEG inference is constrained not only by model size, but also by the channel-dependent sensing front end that must process high-dimensional inputs before compact downstream computation. We present EEG2MCU, a sensing-to-execution co-design framework that treats electrode count as a hardware design variable through task-aware montage selection. EEG2MCU retains a compact time-frequency representation and generates only the INT8 regions required by each first-layer tile, avoiding full input materialization. Halo reuse and access-aware placement across Flash, SRAM, and tightly coupled memory further reduce redundant generation and data movement. On a Cortex-M7 MCU, EEG2MCU reduces peak SRAM by 11.38x relative to the baseline, including a 1.71x reduction from the 62-to-19 electrode montage, while reducing latency by 2.57x and energy by 2.48x. It retains 94-96% of full-montage accuracy, demonstrating practical high-dimensional EEG infe

translated_title: EEG2MCU：面向可穿戴脑电图推理的感知到执行协同设计
translated_abstract: 可穿戴脑电图（EEG）推理不仅受模型规模的限制，还受制于必须在紧凑的下游计算之前处理高维输入的依赖通道的感知前端。我们提出了EEG2MCU，这是一个感知到执行协同设计框架，通过任务感知的电极蒙太奇选择，将电极数量作为硬件设计变量。EEG2MCU保留紧凑的时频表示，并仅生成每个第一层分块所需的INT8区域，避免了完整输入的物化。跨Flash、SRAM和紧耦合内存的Halo重用与访问感知布局进一步减少了冗余生成和数据移动。在Cortex-M7微控制器上，EEG2MCU相对于基线将峰值SRAM占用降低11.38倍（其中62通道到19通道蒙太奇缩减贡献了1.71倍），同时将延迟降低2.57倍，能耗降低2.48倍。它保留了完整蒙太奇准确率的94-96%，展示了实用的高维EEG推理能力。
tldr: EEG2MCU通过任务感知的电极蒙太奇选择将电极数量作为硬件设计变量，并结合按需生成INT8区域和跨内存的Halo重用等协同设计技术，在Cortex-M7微控制器上实现了峰值SRAM降低11.38倍、延迟降低2.57倍、能耗降低2.48倍，同时保留了94-96%的全蒙太奇准确率。
en_tdlr: EEG2MCU is a sensing-to-execution co-design framework that treats electrode count as a hardware design variable through task-aware montage selection, combining on-demand INT8 region generation and halo reuse across memory hierarchies to achieve 11.38x peak SRAM reduction, 2.57x latency reduction, and 2.48x energy reduction on a Cortex-M7 MCU while retaining 94-96% of full-montage accuracy.
